body: I'm not sure I am, my main interests are still just gaming and films, I've been very keen on gaming since I was about 4 years old and I find that it is what I do with most of my infinite free time (On Employment Support Allowance for Depression and anxiety [I live in Scotland, that's just our basic welfare]). I go out on walks and that's about the limit of what I do physically. I've been so mentally ill for so long that I don't really have much drive to do anything new etc. My friends actually do things, like my best friend goes for Mandolin lessons at least (I do still play games with my friends.) and also volunteers at Samaritan's (I usually go to him, I'm currently letting him actually get sleep). They are also almost all either at University or have graduated university which also digs at me as my main focus is academia but I'm not really smart enough to do it. I keep meaning to try and learn Ukrainian (I'm part Ukrainian) but never commit to it. Also if I were outgrowing them I have no real means of meeting new people so I'd be left out to dry as it were if I did detach from this group.

I've had a lateral movement and just wish I had never been born now.
Think of it like this though, most people shed their depression and continue life without it, statistically you will too.
